required_sections.heading: Purpose and Scope
required_sections.purpose: Define the engineering question, intended audience, owned authority, and excluded uses.

required_sections.heading: Design by Contract
required_sections.purpose: State typed preconditions, postconditions, invariants, and fail-closed authority boundaries.

required_sections.heading: Coordinates, Frames, and Time
required_sections.purpose: Declare frames, axes, handedness, origins, transforms, clocks, and synchronization conventions.

required_sections.heading: Units and Dimensions
required_sections.purpose: Bind every symbol and interface quantity to canonical units and dimensional checks.

required_sections.heading: Derivation and Assumptions
required_sections.purpose: Derive the governing equations from explicit assumptions and cite their authority.

required_sections.heading: Algorithm
required_sections.purpose: Specify deterministic inputs, ordered procedure, outputs, complexity, and resource limits.

required_sections.heading: Implementation Symbols
required_sections.purpose: Map equations and variables to stable public code symbols and module surfaces.

required_sections.heading: Error and Failure Semantics
required_sections.purpose: Define invalid, missing, unsupported, cancellation, recovery, and degraded states.

required_sections.heading: Uncertainty and Sensitivity
required_sections.purpose: Quantify uncertainty sources, propagation, sensitivity, and model-conditioned claims.

required_sections.heading: Verification and Validation
required_sections.purpose: Connect code tests, analytical checks, datasets, tolerances, and acceptance criteria.

required_sections.heading: Limits and Applicability
required_sections.purpose: Bound validity ranges, known limitations, unsupported conditions, and extrapolation rules.

required_sections.heading: Worked Examples
required_sections.purpose: Provide reproducible typed inputs, intermediate values, outputs, and interpretation.

required_sections.heading: References and Provenance
required_sections.purpose: Record source identities, licenses, provenance, evidence classes, and unresolved approvals.

required_sections.heading: Revision History
required_sections.purpose: Record versioned calculation, contract, evidence, and limitation changes.
